name: request_ui_action
description: Propose exactly one UI action for a computer-use harness. This tool does not execute the action; the application policy gate decides whether to execute, review, approve or block it.

action_type.description: The UI operation the model proposes.

role.description: Accessible role, or coordinate only when the harness explicitly allows coordinate actions.

name.description: Accessible name or empty string when the action is wait.

test_id.description: Stable data-testid when available; empty string when unavailable.

text.description: Text to type for type actions; empty string otherwise.

reason.description: Short operational reason for the proposed action.

risk_tags.description: Risk tags inferred by the model; the policy gate recomputes these from the UI state before execution.

requires_approval.description: Whether the model believes the action needs human approval. This is advisory; the policy gate is authoritative.
